{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_parsed'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
data_clean = data[data['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders
completed_data = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude rows with customer_age == -1 (missing age)
completed_clean = completed_data[completed_data['customer_age'] != -1]

# Now check if channel and customer_segment are balanced across age groups
# Create age bins for analysis
completed_clean['age_bin'] = pd.cut(completed_clean['customer_age'], bins=[0, 25, 35, 45, 55, 100], labels=['<25', '25-35', '35-45', '45-55', '55+'])

# Cross-tabulate channel vs age bin
print("Channel vs age bin:")
print(pd.crosstab(completed_clean['channel'], completed_clean['age_bin'], margins=True))

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
print("Channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(completed_clean['channel'], completed_clean['customer_segment'], margins=True))"}
